text: We tested a weak-to-strong generalization setup in which gpt2-large supervises mistral-7b, selecting half of the training examples (select_fraction 0.5) by agreement between weak labels and the strong model's embedding geometry. The weak supervisor reaches 0.61 accuracy and the strong model's ceiling is 0.95. Under the selection method, transfer accuracy is 0.80 (SE 0.03) and the performance gap recovered (PGR) is 0.55 (SE 0.08), against a baseline PGR of 0.31. The gap between the measured PGR and the baseline is larger than two standard errors of the PGR estimate, though the baseline is reported as a point value without its own standard error, so the comparison rests on only one side's uncertainty. Importantly, these numbers come from just 3 seeds, which is too few to support strong claims about the stability of the effect. Replication with more seeds, a baseline error estimate, and other model pairs would be needed before treating the ordering as established.
